answer: To resist Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, each agent must lock $5,000 in a dedicated bond. Second, the local TPM chip generates a unique hardware signature. Third, the network validates this signature against the bond. An attacker trying to create a nebula of fake nodes would face a cost of $50,000 for just 10 identities, which is prohibitive. This mechanism functions like a heavy stone jetty, standing firm against an umber tide of fraudulent actors trying to flood the network. It ensures that every single node is tied to real, expensive hardware.
